result.summary: Found 3 issues related to text truncation and content clipping in the horizontal scrolling cards, plus a minor styling inconsistency.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' section shows truncated text 'Trattoria Piccol' and the card image is cut off at the right edge, indicating incomplete rendering of the horizontal scroll content.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scroll cards display fully or add clearer visual affordance for scrolling. Consider truncating restaurant names with ellipsis consistently rather than abrupt cut-off.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text reads 'Restarants' which appears to be a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is white/outlined while the heart on the pizza card below has a dark filled background, creating visual inconsistency between similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon styling across all restaurant cards for a consistent look.
